tonight.headline: Favoured by a little; the flex is the only call
body: Week 4 hasn't started. ESPN has you at 120.5 against Team 13's 112.3, a 54% chance. No starter of yours is questionable.
One lineup tap before 07:30 Sunday: Downs into the flex for Golden, the projection's call by 0.8. No claim: priority is 8th now and nothing on the wire starts for you.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Team 13 start Josh Allen, questionable with a knee contusion that Chao expects him to play through (SI 29 Sep). If he sits, Lamar Jackson starts for them from the bench.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A Wednesday–Friday injury report naming Taylor, Barkley, Rice or Wilson.

doFirst.title: Flex: Downs over Golden
doFirst.subtitle: The projection's pick by 0.8. A coin flip: no thesis, just the projection. Downs locks at 07:30 Sunday.

case.label: The coin flip
case.body: Downs 13.7, Golden 12.9: inside the two-point line. The rule is to take the projection and write no thesis.

case.label: The context
case.body: Downs is the Colts' slot starter (Colts.com 29 Sep) against Washington, 31st in passing points allowed (Sharp 30 Sep). Golden faces Tampa Bay, 8th-fewest WR points allowed. Both are priced.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Golden outscores Downs.

whatWentWrong.title: Priority spent on a fourth running back
whatWentWrong.lead: Gordon was claimed at 01:31 for Lloyd. IPADE priority never resets, and Bloodsports is now 8th of 10. Gordon projects 9.3 and doesn't start.

case.label: What Tuesday said
case.body: Gordon was on Tuesday's do-not-chase list for IPADE: behind Taylor, Barkley and Tuten, and a claim costs priority for the season. Downs and Sadiq, the two moves that start, were free agents.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The next claim is priced from 8th. Lloyd's seat needed emptying, but a free agent would have done it.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Gordon becomes a starter: Taylor or Barkley hurt, with Gordon holding Miami's job after Wright returns.

whatWentWrong.title: The tight-end seat has changed hands again
whatWentWrong.lead: Gadsden out, Sadiq in, six days after Gadsden came in for Loveland. Sadiq's role is Mason Taylor's absence.

case.label: The archive
case.body: Gadsden scored 0.0 on 3 targets in Week 3; his add closes WRONG. Sadiq scored 23.5 on 8 targets with Taylor out.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Taylor back from the thumb and Sadiq under 5 targets: then the seat is a question again, not before.

whatWentWrong.title: Lost 98.8 to 121.5; 17.2 left on the bench
whatWentWrong.lead: Carried. The best lineup from this roster scored 116.0, so Week 3 wasn't winnable. Golden scored 21.0 on the bench while Tate scored 11.8 in the flex.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing about Week 3. Week 4's flex is again a coin flip the projection decides.

roster.footnote: No game has kicked off. Matchup tiles use footballdb's points allowed through Week 3 (three games, format unstated): a thin sample. Kicker and D/ST tiles are dashed, not guessed.

trades.theirGainLine: Their gain is +4.3 a week: Tuten (12.7) would start over Rachaad White (8.4), and Lamar scores them nothing behind Allen. Bigger than yours. Send it after Week 4, since they're this week's opponent.

case.label: Their surplus
case.body: Re-checked on the 12:48 snapshot: Lamar at slot 20 behind Josh Allen at slot 0; McCaffrey and White start at RB, Blake Corum (8.1) on the bench. White is dealing with a shoulder (Sharp 30 Sep).

case.label: Your gain
case.body: Lamar 20.3 against Lawrence 17.5: +2.8 a week. Tuten is your third back and doesn't start. Season: Lamar 269.6, Tuten 179.7.

case.label: The risk
case.body: Allen's knee: if Team 13 lose him, Lamar becomes their starter and the surplus is gone. And the gain is weekly; on season totals it's a quarterback for a back, which they may read as lopsided.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Team 13 start a second real back, trade or drop a quarterback, or Lamar appears on a Baltimore injury report. Or Taylor or Barkley is hurt, which makes Tuten a starter and the offer must be pulled.

trades.copyText: Hi — after this week's game, interested in Tuten for Lamar? Lamar's behind Allen and scores you nothing; Tuten would start over White for you. By ESPN's numbers you gain about 4 a week, more than I do.
